title: A Nested Doll-velopement: Ice Whisker
description: A Nested Doll-velopement: Ice Whisker — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 3, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 3, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Well, it looks like there really isn't any incredibly powerful magic in the Ice Whisker Nested Dolls after all. I did learn something useful, however! If you put something in the Ice Whisker Nested Doll it cools it down and then keeps it cold, but whatever was put into the Nested Doll ends up smelling of cheese and Fizz Rock. With the right spin this thing could really take off!

Would you mind going out and collecting another one of the Ice Whisker Nested Dolls for me? I used the last one because my cats got sick and they all had fevers. The bigger Nested Dolls almost wrecked Her Majesty Haggy, Oopsies, and Prime Minister Whiskers. Wrecked 'em, darn near killed 'em! They are feeling much better now, though. Head off to the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, located off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 3. Once you are there kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll. Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you are done.

Turn-in:

You have the dolls? I can hear the gold coming in already!

Objectives:

  • Ice Whisker Nested Doll ×1

Level range: 90–100
